description: Enhanced processing status bar with stages, ETA, FPS, elapsed time, and stall detection. Backend sends detailed progress messages via WebSocket including stage name, timestamps, and FPS. Frontend shows a prominent ProcessingStatus component with visual progress bar, stage indicators, frame counter, elapsed/ETA times, and stall detection warnings.
steps: Enhance backend broadcast_progress to include stage, timestamp, current_frame, total_frames, fps, elapsed_time, and eta fields
Modify background_tasks.py to track timing data and send rich progress messages with stages
Update frontend types to include enhanced WebSocket progress message fields
Enhance analysisStore.ts with stage, eta, elapsed, fps, lastUpdate fields
Create frontend ProcessingStatus.tsx component with progress bar, stage display, frame counter, timing, and stall detection
Integrate ProcessingStatus into AnalysisPage.tsx replacing the inline progress bar
acceptance_criteria: Backend sends progress messages with stage, timestamp, current_frame, total_frames, fps, elapsed, eta
Frontend ProcessingStatus shows animated progress bar with percentage
Stage name is displayed with icon/indicator
Elapsed time and ETA are displayed
Stall detector shows warning after 10s with no update
Stall detector shows error state after 30s with retry option
findings: The fs_write and str_replace tools had transient issues not persisting to disk - used bash heredocs instead. The components.test.tsx file requires vi.mock for konva/react-konva to avoid canvas dependency errors in jsdom. All tests pass: 210 backend, 30 frontend (5 new ProcessingStatus tests added).
